notes.zh: 官方一覽表只列年度標準保費，未包括保監局徵費、吸煙與非吸煙差額、付款方式差額、折扣及附加保費；保費一般按年齡釐定，續保時可能調整。
notes.en: The official summary lists annual standard premiums only. It excludes the Insurance Authority levy, smoker/non-smoker differences, payment-mode differences, discounts and loadings. Premiums are usually age-banded and may be adjusted on renewal.
